description: Compare two OpenAPI documents and report every breaking change — removed paths and operations, and newly required parameters — with the affected operation named. Before publishing an API change, to see which operations existing callers lose. Do not choose this when you need a full schema compatibility checker, or when the documents are not OpenAPI JSON. Example requests: Diff these two OpenAPI specs and tell me what breaks for existing clients. | Will upgrading this API version break my integration? Here are both specs. | List the breaking changes between the old and new API contract.

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

new_contract.description: The customer's new.json, as text. Supported: OpenAPI 3.x JSON. The proposed OpenAPI document. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

old_contract.description: The customer's old.json, as text. Supported: OpenAPI 3.x JSON. The current OpenAPI document. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_api_contract_diff

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.

title: API breaking-change report
